nodes.speaker: Villager
nodes.text: Beautiful day, isn't it? This village runs on a Raspberry Pi, can you believe it?

nodes.speaker: Villager
nodes.text: Right? 8 gigs of RAM keeping this whole world alive. Technology is something else.

nodes.speaker: Villager
nodes.text: I heard Claude over in the town square knows everything about this place. And the tavern has some great... apps on the menu.
